title: Interior plaster height = storey - slab; wet-room render / band split at the false ceiling
scope: every villa (values below are the owner's 2026-11-13 company figures; printed FFLs govern the storey)
provenance: owner 2026-11-13 (DELIVERY_MODE.md s.3 heights; AGENT_BRIEF 'Heights', 'Company defaults', 'Wet-room wall tiles')
supersedes: R-T556-1 roof-scenario plaster height (the D-39 / DCR-6 build-up bound) for the height of interior plaster

rule.plaster_height_m: H = storey (printed FFL to FFL) - slab 0.16: 4.34 GF, 4.04 upper floors, 3.84 GF annex (+0.30 .. +4.30)
rule.false_ceiling_m: Hc = H - 0.90 (company default); in a wet room never below the 3.00 m tile top
rule.wet_room: render behind tiles (FIN.PLASTER 'plaster') = run x Hc - openings; band above the ceiling = run x (H - Hc); render + band = run x H - openings
rule.dry_room: plaster = face run x H - openings - beam ends (MAIN_FILL_2)
rule.labels: DEFAULT where H / Hc / heads come from the company defaults; DRAWING-READ replaces a figure when the designer prints it

never: a missing wall run valued as 0
the superseded 0.64 m band factor kept beside the owner height
